svg.text: Figure 1 — Development plan and go/no-go gates for BUB1B p.Leu737Ter
Genotype
c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter — codon 737 TTA→TGA — premature stop is UGA, tetranucleotide UGAA, exon 17/23
In-trans: c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys (pseudokinase domain, retains full-length protein) · PTC lies in an unstructured KARD–pseudokinase linker
Phase 0 — patient-cell tractability panel (wk 1–12)
Proband fibroblasts / LCLs. Arms: vehicle · G418 · gentamicin ·
DAP ± NMD inhibitor · TLN468 · SRI-41315 · NV848 ·
Peh 2026 UGAA hits · NMD inhibitor ALONE (safety arm)
Readouts: targeted MS for Trp at residue 737 · full-length BubR1 western vs
WT standard curve · BUB1B transcript · PCS rate, micronuclei, mitotic timing,
kinetochore BubR1/Cdc20 · cytotoxicity at every dose
In parallel: confirm phase · chemo/radiosensitivity panel · obtain Peh compounds
GATE 0 → 1
≥2% full-length BubR1 with MS-confirmed Trp at 737, AND a measurable
fall in PCS rate, AND no functional worsening in the NMD-alone arm
Novel hazard tested here
The truncated protein retains TPR, KEN, GLEBS and KARD but loses
the pseudokinase domain. NMD inhibition alone may stabilise a
dominant-negative species competing for Bub3/Cdc20.
If confirmed, the NMD arm is dropped and everything moves to suppressor tRNA.
Phase 1 — suppressor tRNA design (mo 3–12)
UGA suppressor tRNA charged with leucine — restores the
exact wild-type residue. PERT screening framework across all
418 human tRNA genes, or AAV-delivered construct.
Validate in proband cells; ribosome profiling for readthrough at natural stops.
GATE 1 → 2
≥10% restoration of wild-type BubR1, no detectable readthrough at
natural stop codons, no significant proteomic perturbation
Phase 2 — in vivo, genotype-faithful (mo 12–30)
Build BubR1L737X/N1002K knock-in, following the Sieben 2020
humanised MVA allelic series.
Endpoints: tumour incidence and latency (primary safety gate) · echo, ECG,
cardiac histology · interphase FISH aneuploidy across tissues · behaviour and
dendritic spine morphology (mandatory for any FTSJ1-directed agent) · lifespan
GATE 2 → 3
Phenotype improvement with no increase in tumour incidence
and no neurodevelopmental signal
Independent of all gates — do now
1. Add ECG + echocardiography to the existing 3–4-monthly surveillance
2. Issue the written contraindication card to his clinical team
